title: report
description: A page of sections, each a heading over parts: Markdown text, records of a name and longer text, code, commands at a terminal, images, notes, numbers, steps, checklists, things before and after, options, facts, tables of rows compared both ways, diffs, file trees, links, review findings, folded parts, decisions, fields, timelines, bars of values or of how far things have gone, keys, tabs, scripts, diagrams, or HTML for what they cannot say.

eyebrow.description: A short line above the title, such as the kind of page and its date

lead.description: A sentence or two under the title that sums the page up; a line of Markdown. What looks like a tag (<prefix>, Vec<u8>) is left out and marks such as * and _ are read: write those as text in backticks

sections.description: Subsections drawn after the section's parts, each a heading over parts, one level only
